svg.text: HIGH-LEVEL SDV CABIN HVAC ARCHITECTURE & COMPONENT INTERCONNECTS
3-Tier Physical Separation: Firmware (ESP32-S3) ↔ Vehicle-Based AE (Pi 5) ↔ Server / Network Base CSE (ACMEScripts & TS-0010)

g.text: • Hardware CRC-8 checksum validation per I²C word
+ Auxiliary Safety: CO & IAQ / Exterior AQI
• CO ≥ 30 ppm emergency purge • ΔIAQ damper control
• Core 1: SCD30 polling, bounds check, 25 kHz PWM, PCNT
• Core 0: JSON framing, UART TX/RX, watchdog & fail-safe
Fail-Safe: 50% baseline PWM if UART link lost > 15s
• Blue LED (GPIO 18): 25 kHz PWM Purge Blower (0–100%)
• WS2812B RGB (GPIO 38): Node Health Optical Annunciator
Driven by ΔIAQ (Exterior AQI vs Cabin IAQ)
Module 2: Vehicle AE • 0 Open Ingress Ports
• Publishes TS-0010 MQTT via outbound mTLS 1.3
Local Fallback: 50% PWM if CSE unreachable
• Shared read-only by both Module 2 containers
• Authenticates mutual TLS 1.3 handshake to Mosquitto
• Fault isolation: Vehicle A cannot impact Vehicle B
3. SERVER / NETWORK-BASED • MODULE 1: BASE CSE INFRASTRUCTURE (SERVER / VM)
• External Port 8883: Mutual TLS 1.3 termination (server.crt + ca.crt)
Internal Port 1883: Loopback TS-0010 bridge to ACME IN-CSE
• Isolates WAN TLS crypto from CSE Python threads
• Starts with Zero AEs at Boot (dynamic on-demand onboarding)
• onCreate triggers evaluate SCD30 bounds, CRC-8 & latency
• Multi-hazard rules (CO₂ > 800 ppm, CO ≥ 30 ppm, Stall)
• Direct downlink notifications via sub_downlink (nu: mqtt://...)
✓ Eliminates Node-RED IPE container & HTTP proxy hops
• Evaluates 4-State Health: FRESH | STALE | DEGRADED | FAULT
• Checks τ_age ≤ 2.5s, SCD30 CRC-8, |dT/dt| & blower stall
• Non-coercion: preserves null on FAULT (never fabricates 0)
Decouples high-rate TSDB from CSE TinyDB
• Physical Separation: Firmware (ESP32) ↔ Vehicle AE (Pi 5) ↔ Server CSE
• Zero Trust Perimeter: mTLS 1.3 (:8883) + 0 open ingress ports on Pi 5
• Native Middleware: ACMEScripts + TS-0010 MQTT (no Node-RED IPE)
• Single SCD30 Sensor: Unified CO₂/T/RH with CRC-8 integrity
• Stateless Base CSE: Boots with 0 AEs; dynamic fleet reconciliation
